'''Lost Point''' is a run-down, decrepit [[scout tower]] built by the [[human]]s of [[Theramore (nation)|Theramore]]. It is located in western [[Dustwallow Marsh]], and is currently inhabited by [[Deserter#Theramore deserters|Theramore deserters]]. [[Balos Jacken]] is these deserters' leader, and has information about [[Private Hendel]]'s part in the kidnapping of a very [[Varian Wrynn|important personality]].
